mapper.select: SELECT * FROM MEMBER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET STATUS = 'INACTIVE' , UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT USER_NAME , ROLE_CODE , FAIL_COUNT , LOCKED_AT , USER_NO FROM MEMBER M JOIN MEMBER_LOCK L USING (USER_NO) WHERE IS_LOCKED = 'Y'

SELECT USER_NO , FAIL_COUNT , CASE WHEN (IS_LOCKED = 'N' OR IS_LOCKED = 'Y' AND (SYSDATE > (LOCKED_AT + 10/(24*60)))) THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS IS_LOCKED , LOCKED_AT , LAST_FAIL_AT FROM MEMBER_LOCK WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_LOCK(USER_NO , LOCKED_AT , LAST_FAIL_AT) VALUES(SEQ_USER_NO.CURRVAL , NULL , NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER_LOCK SET IS_LOCKED = 'Y', LOCKED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
UPDATE MEMBER_LOCK SET FAIL_COUNT = 0, IS_LOCKED = 'N' WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
